title_zh: 文学、艺术与体育 — 第25节
body_en: Write a short poem with simple words and strong verbs. Read it aloud to hear the beat. Watch a play or match and note teamwork moments. Creative work is not talent only — it is hours of craft.
body_zh: 用简单词和有力动词写一首短诗。朗读听节奏。看戏或比赛，记下团队合作瞬间。创作不只靠天赋——也靠长时间手艺。
